name: gow3-dev-guard
description: Two-layer deterministic guardrails for the gow3_pc fork: PreToolUse blocks dangerous operations before execution (fail-closed, cd-tracking, staged/worktree git inspection); the independent Audit Gate (tools/audit_gate.py, CLI+CI) verifies the repository's real changes against a trusted reference, including submodules and anti-self-weakening; Stop validates the GOW3 ZCODE FINAL REPORT; SessionStart injects project context.
